data.title: Accomplice gets 5 years over MP car shooting
data.description: The Narathiwat provincial court sentenced a man to five years in prison for his role in an attempted murder case involving Prachachat Party MP Kamolsak Leewamoh.

data.title: Man gets 5 years over shooting MP
data.description: The Narathiwat provincial court sentenced a man to five years in prison for his role in an attempted murder case involving Prachachat Party MP Kamolsak Leewamoh.

data.title: Laos deports 23 gamblers
data.description: NONG KHAI: Twenty-three Thai nationals were deported from Laos on Friday following a crackdown on online gambling networks by Lao authorities, police said on Saturday.

data.title: Public warned on school threats
data.description: <p>The Department of Mental Health has warned against threatening posts targeting schools, urging the public to follow its "2 No, 1 Join" principle: do not share, do not imitate, and report suspicious clues.</p>

data.title: Govt backs new maritime talks chair
data.description: <p>Thailand has welcomed the appointment of Katrina Cooper, Australia's Special Envoy for Greater Sunrise in the Timor Sea, as chair of the Conciliation Commission under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), addressing the maritime dispute between Thailand and Cambodia.</p>

data.title: Govt tightens net on scammers
data.description: <p>The government will intensify efforts to combat online crime from "source to destination", targeting mule accounts and SIM cards, money trails, digital platforms and infrastructure used by criminals, as well as call-centre gangs and transnational crime networks, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.</p>

data.title: Ex-drug kingpin pardoned
data.description: Former drug kingpin Laota Saenlee, 86, has been released from Bang Kwang Central Prison after receiving a royal pardon under a decree issued to mark Her Majesty the Queen's 4th-cycle birthday anniversary.

data.title: Kingdom seeks relief from US tariffs; military leverage denied
data.description: <p>The government is preparing to hold talks with the United States over technical details on tariffs late this month, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said, while dismissing reports Thailand may use military cooperation as leverage.</p>

data.title: PP chief renews call for better oversight
data.description: <p>Opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has renewed his criticism of the political system, saying that weak checks and balances, along with a constitution that allows flawed mechanisms to persist, are at the root of many problems.</p>

data.title: EC urged to bare facts in probe
data.description: <p>The Election Commission (EC) should disclose details of an investigation into alleged money transfers to an official linked to a probe into suspected Senate election fraud, says People's Party (PP) list-MP Parit Wacharasindhu.</p>

data.title: Family questions YouTuber's death certificate
data.description: <p>The family of Thai travel YouTuber Hlun Solo is seeking a clear explanation after a death certificate issued by Georgian authorities failed to state the cause of his demise.</p>

data.title: BMA unveils new city blueprint
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is set to implement a 261-item framework, working with experts to promote city development.</p>

data.title: Govt urged to boost food resilience
data.description: <p>Thailand should use the disruption caused by the Middle East crisis to strengthen the resilience of its agricultural sector against future global shocks, the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) says.</p>

data.title: Thailand seeks EAEU free trade deal
data.description: <p>Talks on a free trade agreement (FTA) between Thailand and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) hopefully will begin soon, helping expand trade with the bloc, says Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow.</p>

data.title: Deputy PM maps out plans for growth
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has urged greater investment in basic infrastructure to propel Thailand into a new economic era.</p>

data.title: All on board safe after longtail boat capsizes off Krabi
data.description: Ten tourists, a guide and a boat skipper were all safely rescued after a longtail boat capsized off Laem Hang Nak in Krabi province on Saturday.

data.title: Israeli mother and daughter badly beaten on Koh Phangan
data.description: A French man accused of brutally attacking an Israeli mother and daughter on Koh Phangan, causing injuries requiring surgery, has reportedly been released on bail of 100,000 baht.

data.title: Young Australian golfer dies in Thailand
data.description: A rising young Australian golf star has died in Thailand after suffering a brain haemorrhage.

data.title: 60 illegal nominee firms found on Koh Samui
data.description: A new crackdown on illegal foreign businesses on Koh Samui has uncovered 60 cases ranging from unlicensed nurseries and luxury pool villas to companies set up to facilitate business visas, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said on Saturday.

data.title: Democrats threaten EC over Senate case
data.description: <p>The Democrat Party has threatened legal action against the Election Commission (EC) if it drops the Senate vote-rigging case.</p>

data.title: PM swats away US drone base rumours
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed reports that the United States plans to establish a drone manufacturing base in Thailand, while reiterating that security matters are not linked to tariff negotiations and that the Cobra Gold military exercise will proceed as usual.</p>

data.title: Anutin to visit New Zealand, Australia
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will pay an official visit to Australia from Aug 17-20 and an official visit to New Zealand from Aug 20-22 at the invitation of the premiers of both countries, government spokesperson Rachada Dhnadirek said.</p>

data.title: Anutin sets out five priorities for air force
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined five policy priorities to strengthen the Royal Thai Air Force's (RTAF) operational capabilities and national security.</p>

data.title: Panel set to oversee data centres
data.description: <p>A national policy committee has been established to oversee the data centre industry, promoting investment while managing its impact on electricity, water, public safety and the environment.</p>

data.title: Poland eyes closer ties with Thailand
data.description: <p>Poland sees Thailand as a key middle-power partner, with the two countries sharing an interest in stronger economic ties, closer political dialogue and upholding a rules-based international order, according to Artur Harazim, Poland's Undersecretary of State for Foreign Affairs.</p>

data.title: President of BAAC faces investigation
data.description: <p>The Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives' (BAAC) board has appointed a representative from the Bank of Thailand to chair a committee tasked with investigating allegations raised by the BAAC labour union, which has accused the bank's president of failing in his duties.</p>

data.title: Govt says scheme isn't a handout
data.description: <p>The government yesterday said its "half-and-half interest" scheme is a funding programme for grassroots communities to reduce reliance on informal loans, not a cash handout.</p>

data.title: PM rejects claims of delay in exam probe
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has rejected claims of delays in the investigation into alleged fraud in the 2025 local government recruitment examinations, saying authorities are reviewing all 800,000 answer sheets and will pursue anyone implicated.</p>

data.title: Testing time for People's Party
data.description: <p>Senate collusion case risks undermining the PP's credibility as it struggles to substantiate allegations against senior govt figures v The TH-AI Passport is set to face tough scrutiny in parliament over cost, transparency and procurement concerns.</p>

data.title: School safety bill in works
data.description: <p>The Education Ministry is preparing a school safety bill for cabinet approval as authorities tighten security following copycat threats of violence at several educational institutions.</p>

data.title: Gun prizes for village leaders axed
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Department of Provincial Administration (Dopa) to stop awarding firearms as prizes to village and subdistrict chiefs.</p>

data.title: Jobless claim 'recruitment scam' cost them B20m
data.description: <p>More than 80 job seekers have filed complaints with anti-human trafficking police, alleging a recruitment agency swindled them out of more than 20 million baht with false promises of jobs in Canada and Finland.</p>

data.title: Dems threaten EC over Senate case
data.description: <p>The Democrat Party has threatened legal action against the Election Commission (EC) if it drops an alleged Senate vote-rigging case.</p>

data.title: Anutin sets out five priorities for RTAF
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has outlined five policy priorities to strengthen the Royal Thai Air Force's (RTAF) operational capabilities and national security.</p>

data.title: Khon Kaen temple land battle heats up
data.description: The abbot of a forest temple in Khon Kaen has produced the original title deed for land donated more than three decades ago, as the donor’s heirs intensify their efforts to reclaim the site.
